$comment: Checks applied to every eval user by agents/evals/run-evals.ts. Each check names what it asserts; the script implements it.

checks.description: The run finishes with status done and no fallback replay.
At least one objection and one concession event.
Every event text is 140 characters or fewer.
Exactly one decision event and it is the last event; it carries data.planId.
The Doctor's first proposal carries data.constraints equal to the stored constraints at the end of the run (never relaxed).
A MealPlan with 7 days and mealsPerDay meals per day is saved as the current plan.
verifyPlan on the saved plan returns no violations (feasible, or bestEffort only over budget).
bestEffort plans cost more than the budget but still pass every rule.
No plan item carries any of the excluded food tags (allergies and restrictions).
For diabetic users every meal is within maxCarbsPerMealG and maxGlycemicLoadPerMeal.
The grocery list is non-empty and its total cost matches the plan's weekly cost within $0.50.
Every meal has explanations from chef, doctor and budget.
Every number in event texts also appears in constraints, profile, plan or optimizer output (scripted mode guarantees this; the check guards regressions).

photos: agents/evals/photos/answers.json holds three answer keys for the scripted vision path (agents/vision/analyze.ts templates).
